content: Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

At MRA Bakery, we specialize in handcrafted bread, pastries, cakes, and savory snacks, offering custom-tailored edible art to meet your unique needs. We also proudly supply our high-quality baked goods to established coffee chains. 

For events, MRA Catering provides exceptional catering services for weddings, anniversaries, school functions, festive gatherings, and more. Our menu features traditional sweets and snacks, including Biriyani, Halal-certified non-vegetarian dishes, desserts, breads, halwas, a variety of cakes and pastries, cashew sweets, savory snacks, and chaat. We also elevate Indian desserts with unique flavors like rose, saffron, and mango, ensuring a memorable culinary experience for every occasion. 

Here are some of our delicious cake offerings:
1. **Pista Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar, sandwiched with Vanilla Fresh Cream and Pista, decorated with Pista Flakes. Price: ₹949. ![Pista Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_122341.png)
2. **Black Currant Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with Vanilla Fresh Cream & Black Currant Crush. Price: ₹899. ![Black Currant Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_122412.png)
3. **Spanish Delight**: Chocolate sponge cake soaked in coffee syrup, sandwiched & topped with Fresh Cream, Hazelnut chocolate, Caramel Sauce, Praline nuts & Melted Dark Chocolate. Price: ₹999. ![Spanish Delight](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124112.png)
4. **Tender Coconut Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in Coconut Sugar syrup, sandwiched & topped with Fresh cream, Milky tender coconut pieces & White chocolate. Price: ₹1049. ![Tender Coconut Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124306.png)
5. **KitKat Cake**: Chocolate sponge soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with Chocolate Fresh Cream and topped with Chocolate Truffle, Kitkat & Gems. Price: ₹1300. ![KitKat Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124154.png)

Explore our delicious offerings and let us bring flavor and creativity to your table!
